title: Reed Jobs Scraper
description: Scrape jobs from Reed.co.uk listings. Provide a keyword and/or location, or a full Reed search URL. The actor paginates results and (optionally) opens job detail pages.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job search keyword(s). Example: Software Developer

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Optional Reed search or listing URL. Example: https://www.reed.co.uk/jobs/software-developer-jobs-in-london

results_wanted.title: Max jobs
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect. Leave empty to collect all available.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on how many listing pages to visit. Leave empty for no cap (the actor still stops at Max jobs).

posted_date.title: Posted date filter
posted_date.description: Optional recency filter (not all values may map directly). Example: today, 3days, 7days, anytime

collectDetails.title: Collect job details
collectDetails.description: If enabled, the scraper also opens each job detail page to capture full description/salary (slower, but richer data).

cookies.title: Custom cookies (raw header)
cookies.description: Optional raw Cookie header string (e.g., "consent=true; session=xyz; abc=123"). Helps bypass consent or guest banners.

cookiesJson.title: Custom cookies (JSON)
cookiesJson.description: Optional JSON for cookies. Accepts an array (e.g., ["consent=true", {"name":"session","value":"xyz"}]) or an object map (e.g., {"consent":"true","session":"xyz"}).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy (recommended). Consider Residential if you encounter blocks.
